legend: Construct a convex hexagon on the plane with an area of S%%ZSMJ0%%, where all coordinates are integers.
input: In a single line, there is one integer S%%ZSMJ1%% (3≤S≤109)%%ZSMJ2%%.
output: Output twelve integers x1,y1,x2,y2,…,x6,y6%%ZSMJ3%% (−109≤xi,yi≤109)%%ZSMJ4%% — the coordinates of the hexagon's vertices. Output the vertices in the order of traversing the figure clockwise or counterclockwise. All points must be different.
